name: Allied First Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Allied First Bancorp, Inc. operates as the holding company for Allied First Bank that provides banking products and services for individuals and small businesses in Illinois. It offers deposit products, such as checking, savings, money market, and certificate of deposit accounts, as well as loan products, including home equity, automobile, boat, and personal loans, along with real estate, residential construction, and commercial loans, as well as credit cards and online and mobile banking services. Allied First Bank was originally chartered as a credit union in 1994 and converted to an Illinois state savings bank in 2000. The company was headquartered in Oswego, Illinois, until it was acquired by ServBanc Holdco, Inc. in October 2022.
